# Changes since Phon 4.0.0-alpha.56
## Project Window
- New project tree window with dialog header, project menu, and window switching between open projects - Media folder browser — the Media node now shows Global and Project media folders with lazy-loaded contents, context menus, and the ability to create sessions directly from media files or reveal files in Finder - Session backup management — view, restore, and delete session backups from a new Manage Backups dialog; backup limit is configurable (default 20 per session) - Session info panel now displays recording info and duration - Project info panel gains Rename Project and Data Check action buttons - Improved button appearance in icon strips with visible borders, rounded corners, and configurable layout - Middle-ellipsis labels for long paths that truncate from the center
## Session Editor
- Corpus template editor now works correctly — opens the proper template editor, initializes the transcript view for new templates, and saves via the SessionTemplate API - Fixed selection escaping tier bounds — selecting within header tiers, comments, and gems no longer cascades into adjacent tiers - Segment overlap detection and auto-fix — the overlap check now correctly identifies and optionally auto-repairs overlapping segments for the same speaker - Session media check with optional auto-fix for mismatched media filenames
## Session Checks
- New settings UI for Session Media Check (check accessibility, CHAT strict mode, fix media name) and Segment Overlap Check (fix overlaps) - Auto-fix mode for both checks: when enabled, fixes are applied directly and reported as informational messages instead of warnings - Session-level validation events (e.g., missing media) now appear correctly in check results
## Icons
- Replaced ca.hedlund.desktopicons dependency with Google Material Design Icons across the entire application
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed intermittent welcome window layout collapse caused by pack() caching collapsed divider positions - Fixed project tree selection not restored after refresh (async child loading race condition) - Fixed NewSessionDialog producing invalid paths for root-level sessions - Fixed corpus extraction confusing folders with session files - Fixed MiddleEllipsisLabel always rendering full text instead of truncated form

# Changes since Phon 3.5
**Note**: This is a pre-release version of Phon 4.0. This version is not feature complete and may contain bugs. Please report any issues to the Phon issue tracker.
## Backend File Format Updates - Major migration to the CHAT transcription system format, affecting how session data is stored and processed Sessions created and upgraded to phon 4 will no longer be compatible with previous versions of Phon.
## User Interface and Experience Improvements
### Editor Navigation and Interaction - Improved movement between syllabification tiers and text tiers - Enhanced tab/shift+tab navigation between alignment and text tiers - Fixed update mechanisms for syllabification component when switching tiers - Added media playback keyboard shortcuts (F2, Ctrl+Enter, and Ctrl+Space) - Added a "reset layout" action to the 'more' button - Reorganized the transcript view toolbar (#277) - Media player has been embedded into the Transcript view and may be externalized into its own window. - Redo keyboard shortcut is now Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z - Play segment keyboard shortcut is now Cmd/Ctrl+Y
### Timeline and Interval Tiers - Renamed 'timeline' and 'timelineTier' to 'intervalTiers' and 'intervalTier' for clarity - Added Phone intervals as a new user tier type - Improved tier alignment with the %wor tier - Enhanced word/phone interval tier updates - Customized tier alignment with %wor tier
### Bug Fixes - Fixed delete participant functionality (#275) - Fixed duplicate session issues (#272) - Fixed WAP (Word-level Analysis of Phonological Patterns) analysis (#278) - Fixed session links in generated HTML reports - Fixed issues with shadow projects looking for old properties file - Fixed issues with GEM content updating when switching tiers
## Analysis Enhancements - Updated numerous phonological analyses to work with the new CHAT format: - Word match analysis - Tier match analysis - Syllable count match analysis - Stress match analysis - CV pattern match analysis - Measure of cluster proximity analysis - Consonants analysis - Vocalization analysis - Phone clusters analysis - Multi-syllabic non-linear analysis - Added PMLU (Phonological Mean Length of Utterance) analysis - Added phonological process analyses
## Notes - Default user preferences will reset for Phon 4 and will no longer affect Phon 3 preferences. - Application Support folder is now named 'Phon4' and will no longer contain Phon 3 data. - Default workspace folder will be <user.home>/Documents/Phon4Workspace.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/phon-ca/phon/compare/3.5.2...4.0.0-alpha.46
